pay:
Instructions for living a life:
Pay attention.
Be astonished.
Tell about it.

In restaurants we argue
over which of us will pay for your funeral though the real question is
whether or not I will make you immortal.

In secondary school, a boy and a girl, both of them teenagers, both of them with the same amount of pocket money, would go out and then the boy would be expected always to pay, to prove his masculinity. And yet we wonder why boys are more likely to steal money from their parents.
We Should All Be Feminists - April 12, 2013
Elegance is a small price to pay for enlightenment, and I was glad to pay it.
Activism is the rent I pay for living on the planet.
From the film poster for Alice Walker: Beauty in Truth.

I don't know exactly what a prayer is.
I do know how to pay attention, how to fall down
into the grass, how to kneel down in the grass,
how to be idle and blessed, how to stroll through the fields,
which is what I have been doing all day.
Tell me, what else should I have done?
Doesn't everything die at last, and too soon?
Tell me, what is it you plan to do
with your one wild and precious life?
paying: I envy paranoids; they actually feel people are paying attention to them.
"Susan Sontag Finds Romance," interview by Leslie Garis, The New York Times (2 August 1992)
pays: A writer, I think, is someone who pays attention to the world. That means trying to understand, take in, connect with, what wickedness human beings are capable of; and not be corrupted — made cynical, superficial — by this understanding.
